name: Le Castle Vania Music Pack
teaser: Get that John Wick vibe going
description_html:
Added some music to change the Main menu to get you in the mood to get some slaying done.

Install Instructions: Put the CustomMusic Folder into your BepinEx/Plugins folder and you are done and good to go or just drag the bepinex folder into main folder.

Songs:
Blood Code - Le Castle Vania
Wetwork - Le Castle Vania
A Long Way Down - Le Castle Vania
Osaka Phonk - Le Castle Vania
Fully Loaded Epic Win - Le Castle Vania
Infinite Ammo - Le Castle Vania
Use of Force - Le Castle Vania
John Wick Mode - Le Castle Vania
LED Spirals (Extended) - Le Castle Vania

If you want to add more of your own music just plop them into the CustomMusic Folder
